item.title: Trump suspends federal diesel taxes to help farmers, but states issue warnings
item.description: President Trump's executive order suspending federal taxes on diesel is aimed at helping farmers but it's more complicated than it sounds and states are warning drivers they may owe taxes later.

item.title: With an ad aimed at Trump, this Republican exposed GOP angst about Latino voters
item.description: Rep. María Elvira Salazar filmed an ad warning the president that he's "gone too far" on immigration. It reflected concern among some Republicans that their gains with Latino voters could be at risk.

item.title: Fraud, affordability and Trump policies drive friction in Minnesota Senate debate
item.description: The major party candidates for Minnesota's U.S. Senate seat faced off in an hourlong debate Friday on MPR News with fraud, affordability and fallout from the Trump administration's policies as key points of friction.
